name: Sheer Khurma
description: Festive Pakistani sheer khurma made with milk, roasted vermicelli, dates, nuts and cardamom, especially popular for Eid.
method: Heat ghee in a heavy pot and lightly roast the vermicelli until golden.
Add the milk and crushed cardamom and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add dates, almonds, pistachios and raisins and cook on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes.
Add sugar and stir until dissolved.
Cook until the vermicelli is soft and the milk is slightly thickened.
Finish with rose water if using and serve warm or chilled.
